relationships.subject: aPir glutamatergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: glutamatergic projections from the aPir (aPir<sup>Glu</sup>) innervate GABAergic neurons in the IC (IC<sup>GABA</sup>) to inhibit local glutamatergic neurons (IC<sup>Glu</sup>) that are hyperactivated in inflammatory pain

relationships.subject: IC GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: glutamatergic projections from the aPir (aPir<sup>Glu</sup>) innervate GABAergic neurons in the IC (IC<sup>GABA</sup>) to inhibit local glutamatergic neurons (IC<sup>Glu</sup>) that are hyperactivated in inflammatory pain

relationships.subject: lavender essential oil
relationships.evidence_quote: we found that inhalation exposure to 0.1% LEO confers antinociceptive effects in mice with complete Freund adjuvant (CFA)-induced inflammatory pain through activation of projections from the anterior piriform cortex (aPir) to the insular cortex (IC)

relationships.subject: aPir glutamatergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Conversely, artificial inhibition of IC-projecting aPir<sup>Glu</sup> neurons abolishes LEO-induced antinociception.

key_findings: Inhaled 0.1% lavender essential oil produced antinociception in CFA inflammatory pain mice via aPir glutamatergic projections to insular cortex.
aPirGlu inputs drive IC GABAergic neurons that inhibit hyperactive IC glutamatergic neurons; activating this pathway mimicked, and inhibiting it abolished, LEO antinociception.
